<?php

namespace CloudSDK\IAM;

class FeatureFlagService
{
    private $redis;
    private $flagCache = [];

    public function __construct($redisConnection)
    {
        $this->redis = $redisConnection;
    }

    public function isEnabled(string $flagName, array $context = []): bool
    {
        $cacheKey = $this->buildCacheKey($flagName, $context);
        if (isset($this->flagCache[$cacheKey])) {
            return $this->flagCache[$cacheKey];
        }

        $flagConfig = $this->redis->hGetAll("feature_flags:{$flagName}");
        if (empty($flagConfig)) {
            return false;
        }

        $result = $this->evaluateFlag($flagConfig, $context);
        $this->flagCache[$cacheKey] = $result;
        return $result;
    }

    private function evaluateFlag(array $config, array $context): bool
    {
        if (($config['enabled'] ?? '0') !== '1') {
            return false;
        }

        if (!empty($config['rollout_rules'])) {
            return $this->evaluateRolloutRules(
                json_decode($config['rollout_rules'], true),
                $context
            );
        }

        return true;
    }

    private function evaluateRolloutRules(array $rules, array $context): bool
    {
        foreach ($rules as $rule) {
            if ($this->matchesRule($rule, $context)) {
                return (bool)($rule['serve'] ?? false);
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private function matchesRule(array $rule, array $context): bool
    {
        foreach (($rule['conditions'] ?? []) as $condition) {
            if (!$this->evaluateCondition($condition, $context)) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    private function evaluateCondition(array $condition, array $context): bool
    {
        $attribute = $condition['attribute'] ?? '';
        $operator = $condition['operator'] ?? 'eq';
        $value = $condition['value'] ?? null;
        $contextValue = $this->resolveAttribute($attribute, $context);

        return $this->compareValues($contextValue, $operator, $value);
    }

    private function resolveAttribute(string $attribute, array $context)
    {
        $parts = explode('.', $attribute);
        $current = $context;
        foreach ($parts as $part) {
            if (is_array($current) && array_key_exists($part, $current)) {
                $current = $current[$part];
            } else {
                return null;
            }
        }
        return $current;
    }

    private function compareValues($contextValue, string $operator, $value): bool
    {
        switch ($operator) {
            case 'eq': return $contextValue == $value;
            case 'neq': return $contextValue != $value;
            case 'in': return in_array($contextValue, (array)$value);
            case 'gte': return $contextValue >= $value;
            case 'lte': return $contextValue <= $value;
            default: return false;
        }
    }

    private function buildCacheKey(string $flagName, array $context): string
    {
        return $flagName . ':' . md5(serialize($context));
    }
}

class PolicyEngine
{
    private $featureFlags;
    private $policyStore;

    public function __construct(FeatureFlagService $featureFlags, $policyStore)
    {
        $this->featureFlags = $featureFlags;
        $this->policyStore = $policyStore;
    }

    public function authorize(string $principal, string $action, string $resource): bool
    {
        $identity = $this->policyStore->getIdentity($principal);
        if (!$identity) {
            return false;
        }

        $context = [
            'identity' => $identity,
            'request' => [
                'action' => $action,
                'resource' => $resource,
                'timestamp' => time()
            ]
        ];

        // Check if enhanced RBAC is enabled via feature flag
        $useEnhancedRbac = $this->featureFlags->isEnabled('enhanced_rbac', $context);

        if ($useEnhancedRbac) {
            return $this->evaluateEnhancedPolicy($identity, $action, $resource, $context);
        }

        return $this->evaluateLegacyPolicy($identity, $action, $resource);
    }

    private function evaluateEnhancedPolicy(array $identity, string $action, string $resource, array $context): bool
    {
        $policies = $this->policyStore->getPoliciesForRoles($identity['roles'] ?? []);
        $effectivePermissions = $this->computeEffectivePermissions($policies, $context);

        foreach ($effectivePermissions as $perm) {
            if ($this->matchesPermission($perm, $action, $resource)) {
                return $perm['effect'] === 'allow';
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    private function evaluateLegacyPolicy(array $identity, string $action, string $resource): bool
    {
        $roles = $identity['roles'] ?? [];
        $allowedActions = [];

        foreach ($roles as $role) {
            $rolePerms = $this->policyStore->getLegacyPermissions($role);
            $allowedActions = array_merge($allowedActions, $rolePerms);
        }

        return in_array($action, $allowedActions);
    }

    private function computeEffectivePermissions(array $policies, array $context): array
    {
        $permissions = [];
        foreach ($policies as $policy) {
            if ($this->policyApplies($policy, $context)) {
                $permissions = array_merge($permissions, $policy['statements'] ?? []);
            }
        }

        // Sort: explicit deny first, then allow
        usort($permissions, function ($a, $b) {
            if ($a['effect'] === 'deny' && $b['effect'] !== 'deny') return -1;
            if ($b['effect'] === 'deny' && $a['effect'] !== 'deny') return 1;
            return 0;
        });

        return $permissions;
    }

    private function policyApplies(array $policy, array $context): bool
    {
        $conditions = $policy['conditions'] ?? [];
        foreach ($conditions as $condition) {
            $attr = $condition['attribute'] ?? '';
            $op = $condition['operator'] ?? 'eq';
            $val = $condition['value'] ?? null;

            $resolved = $this->resolveContextValue($attr, $context);
            if (!$this->checkCondition($resolved, $op, $val)) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    private function resolveContextValue(string $path, array $context)
    {
        $segments = explode('.', $path);
        $node = $context;
        foreach ($segments as $seg) {
            if (is_array($node) && isset($node[$seg])) {
                $node = $node[$seg];
            } else {
                return null;
            }
        }
        return $node;
    }

    private function checkCondition($resolved, string $op, $value): bool
    {
        switch ($op) {
            case 'eq': return $resolved == $value;
            case 'neq': return $resolved != $value;
            case 'in': return in_array($resolved, (array)$value);
            default: return false;
        }
    }

    private function matchesPermission(array $perm, string $action, string $resource): bool
    {
        $permAction = $perm['action'] ?? '';
        $permResource = $perm['resource'] ?? '';

        return ($permAction === '*' || $permAction === $action) &&
               ($permResource === '*' || fnmatch($permResource, $resource));
    }
}
